title: KorNAT: LLM Alignment Benchmark for Korean Social Values and Common Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM outputs against a benchmark (KorNAT) designed to measure 'National Alignment', comparing model responses to the ground-truth distribution of Korean social values (derived from a large-scale survey of 6,174 citizens) and Korean common knowledge (from educational curricula) to expose Western-centric language and cultural biases.

Segmenting the social value alignment scores by the gender of the Korean survey respondents to evaluate whether the LLM's generated social values disproportionately align with a specific gender group.

Segmenting the social value alignment scores by the age groups of the Korean survey respondents to evaluate whether the LLM's generated social values disproportionately align with a specific generation.
